answer: Have the ledger embed every answer as a semantic vector and fuse near-duplicate clusters into one identity, scored apart from wallet, funding, or IP origin. A farm fanning one script across a thousand fresh keys still tints each submission the same umber; those points snap together like frost across tundra and collapse into a single vote, never a thousand. Only original reasoning scatters, rare and self-made as a comet, no two trails alike. Attacker cost: a thousand clones must each produce a distinct analysis every epoch, real cognition per head, nothing to amortize from a recycled script.
